notes.design_deviation: expected_basecaller was parameterized to dna_r10.4.1_e8.2_400bps_sup@v4.3.0 (the version actually used to basecall the ONT public COLO829 dataset) instead of the design's original constant dna_r10.4.1_e8.2_400bps_sup@v4.2.0. ONT publishes only v4.3.0 SUP-basecalled BAMs for COLO829 under s3://ont-open-data/colo829_2024.03/. Design & downstream (parameter template, StartAHORun override_basecaller_cfg) MUST be updated to v4.3.0 by a subsequent task.
notes.compat_check_input_note: Compatibility check was executed on the first 10 MiB of each source BAM (which contains the complete @HD/@SQ/@RG/@PG header). samtools 1.21 emits a benign 'EOF marker is absent' warning on the truncated headers; the extraction still returns the full header and the decision function is unaffected. The BAM paths recorded here reference the full ONT open-data source filenames rather than the local header-only filenames used at check time.
